en: A colored postcard view of a tranquil pond with rowing boats and swans in the foreground. On the far shore are trees, landscaped flowerbeds, a small half-timbered building with a red roof, and a larger hall-like building on a gently rising hillside. Curved paths run through the park-like setting. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as a gondola pond in the citizens' garden of Döbeln.
